name: input_teleporttoentity
about: TeleportToEntity moves the NPC onto the named entity. CAI_BaseNPCTroika::InputTeleportToEntity 0x102c24a0 (FIELD_EHANDLE; docs/vtmb/entity_io.md): origin and angles of the target, Relink, think reset, ForceTransmit; no schedule change and no output. The wire's form is the corpus's (ch_hub_1: hunter_1 'hunter_1_spot_1'); the target here is a hand-written info_teleport_destination row, w_teleport_spot, on the arena's corner_sw. sp_tutorial_1's Hunter1 (npc_VHumanCombatant, D_LI 0, use_interesting 0, dialogname dlg/generic/hunter1.dlg) verbatim, the player at the start, in its view.
